<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#020617; --sky-50:#f0f9ff; --gray-50:#f9fafb; --gray-200:#e5e7eb;
    --accent:#38bdf8; --text:#0f172a; --text-soft:#475569;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  body{font-family:'Inter',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--text); line-height:1.55; margin:0;}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; line-height:1.15; margin:0;}
  .wrap{max-width:1120px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 24px;}
  .eyebrow{font-size:13px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent); margin-bottom:12px; display:block;}
  section{padding:88px 0;}
  .pill{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-radius:999px; padding:14px 28px; font-weight:600; font-size:15px; text-decoration:none; border:2px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s ease;}
  .pill:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .pill-primary{background:var(--accent); color:var(--navy);}
  .pill-outline{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4); color:#fff;}
  .pill-dark{background:var(--navy); color:#fff;}

  .site-header{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:40; background:rgba(255,255,255,.95); backdrop-filter:blur(8px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200);}
  .site-header .wrap{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:14px 24px;}
  .brand{display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-decoration:none; color:var(--text); line-height:1.1;}
  .brand .word{font-family:'Space Grotesk'; font-weight:700; font-size:19px;}
  .brand .word span{color:var(--accent);}
  .brand .tagline{font-size:11px; color:var(--text-soft); font-weight:500;}
  nav{display:flex; gap:28px; align-items:center;}
  nav a{color:var(--text); text-decoration:none; font-size:14px; font-weight:500;}
  nav a:hover{color:var(--accent);}
  .header-cta{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;}
  .phone-link{font-weight:600; color:var(--text); text-decoration:none; font-size:14px;}
  .nav-toggle{display:none; background:none; border:0; padding:6px; font-size:22px; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; color:var(--text);}
  .header-cta .pill{white-space:nowrap;}
  @media (max-width:900px){
    nav{display:none;}
    .nav-toggle{display:inline-flex;}
    .site-header.nav-open nav{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; position:absolute; top:100%; left:0; right:0; background:#fff; border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200); padding:18px 24px;}
  }

  .hero{background:var(--navy); color:#fff; padding:96px 0 72px;}
  .hero .badge{display:inline-flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); border-radius:999px; padding:8px 16px; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:24px;}
  .hero h1{font-size:48px; color:#fff; max-width:820px;}
  .hero h1 .accent{color:var(--accent);}
  .hero p.lead{max-width:660px; font-size:17px; color:#cbd5e1; margin:22px 0 32px;}
  .hero .cta-row{display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:44px;}
  .trust-row{display:flex; gap:32px; flex-wrap:wrap; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); padding-top:26px;}
  .trust-row div{font-size:14px; color:#e2e8f0; font-weight:500;}

  .bg-sky{background:var(--sky-50);}
  .bg-white{background:#fff;}
  .bg-gray{background:var(--gray-50); border-top:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200);}
  .bg-navy{background:var(--navy); color:#fff;}
  .bg-accent{background:var(--accent);}

  .section-head{max-width:680px; margin-bottom:48px;}
  .section-head h2{font-size:32px;}
  .section-head p{color:var(--text-soft); margin-top:14px; font-size:15.5px;}
  .bg-navy .section-head p{color:#cbd5e1;}

  .grid{display:grid; gap:24px;}
  .grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}
  .grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .grid-2,.grid-3,.grid-4{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  .feature{padding:4px;}
  .feature .icon{font-size:28px; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .feature h3{font-size:17px; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .feature p{color:var(--text-soft); font-size:14px; margin:0;}

  .area-chip{background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius:12px; padding:16px; text-align:center; font-weight:600; font-size:14.5px;}

  .check-list{list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; display:grid; gap:14px;}
  .check-list li{display:flex; gap:10px; font-size:14.5px; color:var(--text-soft);}
  .check-list li b{color:var(--text); font-weight:600;}
  .check-list li::before{content:"✓"; color:var(--accent); font-weight:700; flex-shrink:0;}
  .bg-navy .check-list li{color:#cbd5e1;}
  .bg-navy .check-list li b{color:#fff;}

  details.faq{background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius:12px; padding:18px 22px; margin-bottom:12px;}
  details.faq summary{font-weight:600; font-size:15px; cursor:pointer; list-style:none;}
  details.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
  details.faq summary::after{content:"+"; float:right; font-size:20px; color:var(--accent);}
  details.faq[open] summary::after{content:"-";}
  details.faq p, details.faq ul{color:var(--text-soft); font-size:14px; margin:14px 0 0;}
  details.faq ul{padding-left:20px;}

  .cta-banner{text-align:center;}
  .cta-banner h2{font-size:32px; max-width:700px; margin:0 auto;}
  .cta-banner p{margin:14px 0 28px; font-size:15.5px;}
  .cta-banner .cta-row{display:flex; gap:16px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap;}

  footer{padding:48px 0; background:var(--navy); color:#cbd5e1;}
  footer p{color:#94a3b8; font-size:14px; margin:0;}
  .footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); padding-top:20px; margin-top:24px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; font-size:13px; color:#94a3b8;}
  footer a{color:#cbd5e1; text-decoration:none;}
  .topbar{background:var(--navy);}
  .topbar-inner{max-width:1120px; margin:0 auto; padding:7px 24px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:13px;}
  .open-status{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-weight:600; color:#fff;}
  .os-dot{width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; background:#4ade80; flex:none;}
  .open-status.is-open .os-dot{animation:ospulse 1.5s ease-out infinite;}
  .open-status.is-closed .os-dot{background:#94a3b8;}
  .os-text{font-weight:700; color:#4ade80;}
  .open-status.is-closed .os-text{color:#cbd5e1;}
  .os-sep{color:#64748b;}
  .os-clock{color:var(--accent); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em;}
  @keyframes ospulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,.7);} 70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(74,222,128,0);} 100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0);}}
</style>
bodyHtml:
🛒 Independent, No-Commission Buying Advice · Gold Coast & Surrounds

Laptop & Computer Buying Service Gold Coast. We Find The Right Device, Not The Best Commission.

Tired of pushy sales pitches at the big-box tech stores? Based on the Gold Coast with sourcing reach across Australia, we act as your personal tech shopper, telling us how you work, play or study, then scouring trusted national suppliers for the right laptop or desktop at the best price, instead of steering you toward whatever's on the shelf or whatever earns the biggest commission.

Help Me Buy A Laptop
✓ Independent Advice
✓ Zero Commission Bias
✓ Australia-Wide Sourcing
✓ Setup Included On Request
Why It Matters

In-Store Options Are Limited By What's On The Shelf.

Looking for a high-quality laptop or desktop without settling for whatever's left at JB Hi-Fi, Harvey Norman or The Good Guys? Retail staff sell what they have in stock, not necessarily what suits you, and commission structures can push you toward the model that earns the biggest bonus rather than the best fit.

Our Approach

We Shop Nationally, You Get Exactly What Suits You.

Computers Gold Coast delivers expert, personalised device sourcing across Australia, so you get exactly the specs you need, nothing bloated, nothing missing, often for the same money or less than the retail "special." We'll also recommend free or one-off-cost software alternatives so you're not locked into pricey subscriptions year after year.

Tailored To Your Needs

Whatever You Use It For, We Match The Device To You.

🎓

Student-Ready Laptops

Lightweight builds, long battery life and education-centric software compatibility.

🎮

Gaming Rig Sourcing

Powerful GPU, fast refresh-rate screens and efficient cooling, without paying for gimmicks.

💼

Business & Professional

Robust specs in a lightweight chassis, privacy shutters and enterprise-level support options.

👵

Seniors & Everyday Use

Simple interfaces, readable fonts, easy setup and reliable day-to-day performance.

🎨

Creative Workstations

Fast CPU, 4K or touchscreen, colour-accurate displays and SSD storage for photo and video work.

🖥️

Desktops & Small Business Fleets

Bulk sourcing for small teams, matching each role's needs and budget without a mismatched brand mix.

How It Works

Time-Saving, Stress-Free Sourcing.

From first conversation to a device on your desk, here's how the process runs.

1️⃣

Understanding Your Requirements

We discuss usage, OS preference, budget, timeframe and must-have features like SSD, touchscreen or USB-C.

2️⃣

Researching The Best Options

We scan Australia-wide stock across verified outlets and compare specs, value, warranties and shipping costs.

3️⃣

Presenting Tailored Recommendations

You get a sourcing report with model, retailer, price, specs summary, pros & cons, and our best pick.

4️⃣

Purchase & Delivery

You order directly with no markups. We advise on shipping, warranty and returns, and can set the device up too.

Why Let Us Do The Shopping?

Reasons Gold Coast Buyers Use A Sourcing Service.

  • Independent advice, no brand quotas, just what genuinely fits you.
  • Smart savings, bulk-buyer pricing and zero commission bias.
  • Time back in your day, skip store queues and jargon overload.
  • Future-proof picks, hardware and software that grow with you.
  • Access to nationwide retailers, JB Hi-Fi, Harvey Norman, Dell, Lenovo, HP, ASUS, Acer, Microsoft, Apple and trusted resellers all in the search.
  • Avoid run-out models, we track stock and delivery options, so there's no "sorry, sold out."

Once you've got the device sorted, our new computer setup service handles software updates, driver installation, data migration and antivirus configuration so it's ready to use from day one.

Help Me Buy A Laptop
Sourcing Fee

A Transparent Fee, No Commission Markup.

We charge a flat fee for our time and research, not a percentage of whatever you buy, so there's no incentive to steer you toward a pricier model. The exact fee depends on how involved the search is, so call for a straight quote before you commit to anything.

🧭

Search Complexity

A straightforward student laptop is quicker to source than a specialist creative or gaming rig.

👨‍💼

Single Device Or Bulk Order

We offer bulk sourcing for small business teams, matching each role's needs and budget.

♻️

New Or Refurbished

Open to a cost-saving refurbished option with warranty? We'll scout that too.

🛠️

Optional Setup Service

Add on device setup, hardware check, antivirus install and email syncing once it arrives.

Get in touch for a no-obligation chat about your ideal device and what it would cost to source.

After You've Bought It

Ongoing Support Doesn't Stop At Delivery.

We're onsite or remote-ready for follow-up once your new device arrives.

💾

Software Updates & Drivers

Get everything current before you start using the device day to day.

📂

Data Migration & Backup

Move your files, photos and settings across, and set up ongoing backups from the start.

🔐

Privacy & Antivirus

Sensible privacy settings and antivirus protection configured before you go online.

📞

Friendly Post-Purchase Support

Questions after the fact? Call and we'll talk you through it.

If your current machine turns out to be worth saving instead of replacing, our laptop repairs team can give it a second opinion before you spend anything on a new one.

Related Services

Pairs Well With Buying A New Device.

🖥️

New Computer Setup

Once your new laptop or desktop arrives, our new computer setup service gets it configured and ready to use.

📂

Data Backup & Transfer

Bringing files across from an old machine? Data backup & transfer moves everything safely and sets up ongoing backups.

🔧

Computer Tune-Up

Not sure if your current device needs replacing at all? A computer tune-up might buy it another year or two.

Ready For Honest, No-Commission Buying Advice?

Tell us your needs and budget, and let us do the heavy lifting.

Help Me Buy A Laptop
Where We Work

Service Areas.

We're based on the Gold Coast, with buying advice and setup available across the region, and sourcing reach across Australia.

Frequently Asked Questions

Laptop & Computer Buying Questions, Answered.

What is a laptop and computer buying service?

It's a personalised sourcing service, we find and recommend the right device across Australia based on your specific needs, not just what's on a retail shelf today.

Do you charge a fee for this service?

Yes, a flat sourcing fee covers our research and selection. You purchase the device directly, with no markup added on top.

How do you differ from JB Hi-Fi or Harvey Norman?

They sell what they have in stock. We find what's best for you from suppliers across the country, with no commission bias toward any particular brand.

Can I order multiple devices for a business?

Yes. We offer bulk sourcing for small teams, matching each role's needs and budget.

Can you find refurbished or discounted models?

Absolutely, if you're open to cost-saving refurbished gear, we'll scout the best options with warranty nationwide.

Do you help set up my laptop after purchase?

Yes. We offer in-home or remote setup including software install, data transfer, email setup and security configuration, see our new computer setup service.

Is this service only available on the Gold Coast?

No, while we're based on the Gold Coast, our sourcing reach extends across Australia. Local setup and follow-up support are focused on the Gold Coast and South East Queensland.

Can I source MacBooks or Linux laptops?

Yes. We handle Apple hardware and can source devices that suit Linux or Windows use, whatever fits your workflow.

Skip Retail. Let Us Find Your Device.

Call Computers Gold Coast or get in touch online for a no-obligation chat about your ideal laptop or computer.

Help Me Buy A Laptop
